verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a deprecation policy, sunset timelines, or a versioning scheme that integrators can pin to. The only version-related item is an internal OpenAPI info version (1.357.8) embedded in per-endpoint specs, which is a build number rather than an API versioning or deprecation commitment. A page labeled 'legacy' does not amount to a documented deprecation policy either.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
